provenance: Integration review of the framed Given/Shared/Functions chapters and upstream link-audit changes. Read the changed raw units and exact selected declarations/tests, compared the previously reviewed unchanged material and unit-specific reasoning, and reviewed links, target passages and exceptional forward references against retained chapter context. Corrected stale local-completion descriptions and misplaced/missing definition links. No subagents or independent reviewers were used. Conservative full-source snapshots are freshness inputs, not a claim to have audited every proof tactic.
rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.math.judgment.selection against rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:select, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:extract_case, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:render_authored, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_judgments_and_rules_keep_tex_and_show_cited_source, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_math_requires_one_opening_argument_and_a_body, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:authored_math_rejects_missing_or_wrong_kind_source_selections, test:mdbook-dada/src/lean.rs:tests::selects_a_case_without_interpreting_its_binders. select requires an inductive judgment; rule selection splits the constructor name, retains the inductive header plus exactly that constructor, and leaves binder interpretation untouched. Tests demonstrate authored TeX preservation, exclusion of neighboring cases, complex binders, wrong kinds, argument count and empty body errors. No Prop-result check is asserted or implemented. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.sources.exact_selection.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review. Implementation and test inspection does not establish universal correctness, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution. Mechanical results are retained separately.
